baseline.title: Baseline
baseline.default: No reuse baseline supplied; compare usefulness with current practice manually.

provenance_note.title: Provenance Note
provenance_note.default: Generated draft. Only the linked evidence is source-supported; every other statement is proposed content requiring human verification before use.

ArtifactDraft.title: ArtifactDraft
ArtifactDraft.description:
An actual drafted artifact, not instructions for producing one. `content` is proposed
material; only `grounded_evidence_ids` is backed by verified source quotations.

EvidenceRejection.title: EvidenceRejection
EvidenceRejection.description:
An explicit, recorded outcome for a model quotation that could not be resolved to exactly
one place in the stored normalized source. Rejected quotations never become evidence.

LLMInfo.title: LLMInfo
LLMInfo.description: Non-secret configuration only. No credential, profile or token is ever reported.

LLMInteraction.title: LLMInteraction
LLMInteraction.description:
Metadata for one model call. The request and response bodies are written to the asset
store under `record_key`, never to Git or to ordinary application logs.

ProviderRecord.title: ProviderRecord
ProviderRecord.description: What actually produced a live bundle: provider, model, prompt versions and token usage.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Local reference PoC, not a reproduction or validation of Paper B. No live LLM calls. Candidates are provisional; lexical evidence is not proof of capability, ownership, independence, or realized value.

SemanticAssessment.title: SemanticAssessment
SemanticAssessment.description:
Model-written assessment. Kept separate from the lexical-overlap fields, which stay
`not_assessed`/empty in live mode because no lexical overlap was computed. No score is
produced: a number here would imply a calibration this application does not have.
